author: polariscampus
text:
What if Al could help catch cancer before it’s too late? 🧬 

Two Polaris students, Shivadharushni M and Chandan KT, are working with a team at California State University, Fullerton, to explore exactly that.

Their research focuses on training Al to detect skin lesions, with a particular focus on catching melanoma rather than overlooking it.

But in healthcare, getting the answer right isn’t enough. Knowing when the Al isn’t sure matters just as much.

A fascinating look at how student research, international collaboration, and Al are coming together to explore a problem that could make a real difference.

Research papers are hard enough. Decoding them shouldn’t be ✨

Meet Priyanshu, a Polaris student building an Al-powered Research Paper Summarizer to make complex research easier to navigate.

Upload a paper, get a quick overview of its key ideas and findings, or dive deeper into the methodology, datasets, results, and limitations. You can even simplify technical jargon or focus on one specific section.

The goal isn’t just to read research faster. It’s to understand it better and actually use what you learn.Q
